## 2026-09-22 — Q2.1: Taxonomy structure

**Context:** Same structure decision as Infrastructure and Networking —
single-parent tree vs. a multi-parent/tagging scheme.

**Bucket:** [Standard]/AI-draftable.

**Drafted:** Single-parent tree, mirroring the 10 Definitions subdomains
as the top-level branches 1:1 (no independent classification scheme).
All 64 owned terms classified; the 5 referenced terms excluded per the
same rule Networking used for its 3 referenced Infrastructure terms.

**Status:** Pending explicit review — consistent with the accepted
pattern for Infrastructure and Networking Taxonomies.
